nodes.body: **Installed skills use wrong paths** The lane skills tell the agent to read `prompts/...` and run `python3 scripts/

Fixed in a60fb36. Lane skills now read `$SWARM_ROOT/<prompt>` and run `python3 "$SWARM_ROOT/scripts/<script>.py" --root <target repo> --json` (the bun twin uses the same root and `--root`). The target tree is not used as the script location.

**Missing exports delete working skills** `export_sources` silently accepts a missing lane skill because it collects only files that exist. After a complete install, deleting `swarm-code/SKILL.md` from the source makes the next install delete its unchanged target copy and remove it from the stamp, even though the seat map still declares the `code` lane. Require a skill for every lane declared in the seat map before planning writes or removals. Greptile automatically discovered a related ticket stating that the export must include a skill for each lane, which informed this comment. **Knowledge Base Used:** [Agent artifact generation](https://app.greptile.com/swcstudio/-/custom-context/knowledge-base/swcstudiospace/agent-swarm/-/docs/agent-artifact-generation.md) **Source Used:** Linear — [\[n6\] B5: generate and test the Grok Bot seat map](https://linear.app/swcstudio/issue/SPE-8535/n6-b5-generate-and-test-the-grok-bot-seat-map)

Fixed in a60fb36. `export_sources` requires a skill for every lane named in the seat map before it plans writes or removals. `test_installer_refuses_a_source_missing_a_declared_lane` drops `swarm-code/SKILL.md` from an otherwise complete source and checks that the installed copy and stamp stay unchanged.

**Runner routes to wrong seats** Filtering `_RUNNER_SCRIPTS` here removes `scripts/swarm_run.py` and its TypeScript twin from A01's `path_globs`. The broad language globs then send the Python file to A05 and the TypeScript file to A06, rather than the orchestrator seat described by the comment above. Fixed in a60fb36. `_script_globs` keeps `scripts/swarm_run.py` and `scripts/ts/swarm_run.ts` on A01. `_lane_skill` still omits the runner from the procedure. `resolve_owner` sends both paths to bot-00-programming-lead.

**Shared scripts have two seats** “Longest role glob wins” cannot resolve `scripts/code_checks.py` or `scripts/ts/code_checks.ts`. A05 and A06 claim the same literal paths but name different seats and verification tools. Desk Lead cannot use the map alone to choose between them. Choose one owner for each shared script or define a tie-break, then test these equal-length matches. **Knowledge Base Used:** [Agent roles and skills](https://app.greptile.com/swcstudio/-/custom-context/knowledge-base/swcstudiospace/agent-swarm/-/docs/agent-roles-and-skills.md)

Fixed in a60fb36. Precedence is `routing-before-roles; longest role glob wins; equal length: lowest role id`. A05 and A06 still both list the two literals. `resolve_owner` sends `scripts/code_checks.py` and `scripts/ts/code_checks.ts` to A05 (`bot-01-systems-backend`).

**Rejected builds leave changed files** `render_grokbot` checks the roster after the other generated files have already been written. If `SWARM_AGENTS_FILE` names a roster that fails the intended 15-role check, the build raises with the Claude, Grok, Cursor and OMP outputs changed but the seat map still old. Compute and validate `grok_files` before the first write so a rejected roster does not leave a partial build. **Knowledge Base Used:** [Agent artifact generation](https://app.greptile.com/swcstudio/-/custom-context/knowledge-base/swcstudiospace/agent-swarm/-/docs/agent-artifact-generation.md)

Fixed in a60fb36. `render_grokbot` runs before the first generated write. `test_rejected_roster_writes_nothing` points `SWARM_AGENTS_FILE` at a 16-role manifest and checks that `.claude`, `.grok`, `.cursor`, `omp`, and `grokbot` stay byte-identical.

**Manual APPROVED skips the issuer check** A manual `--transition APPROVED` bypasses the issuer rule that reconcile applies, so a target can be approved while the gate task that issued its row was refused. Apply the same check inside `TaskStore.transition`. **Knowledge Base Used:** - [Task store](https://app.greptile.com/swcstudio/-/custom-context/knowledge-base/swcstudiospace/agent-swarm/-/docs/task-store.md)

Apply the same check inside `TaskStore.transition`. `````
Consider documenting why this flag defaults to off.

Fixed in a60fb36. `--only` now selects lane skills as well as role files. `test_only_leaves_unselected_lanes_untouched` keeps a drifted `swarm-code` skill in place under `--only a01-orchestrator`, and `--check --only a01-orchestrator` does not report that lane.

**Selective builds include unrelated lanes** This loop ignores `--only`. With `--only a01-orchestrator`, the existing loop skips other roles, but the new loop still regenerates all six Grok Bot lanes. It can rewrite `swarm-code` after an unrelated prompt change, and `--check --only ...` can fail on unrelated lane drift. Apply the selector to lane outputs too and test that unselected lanes stay untouched.
